symptom: In PowerShell, py -c and py -m pytest fail with Access is denied / Cannot run a document in the middle of a pipeline, while python is not recognized.
oracle: Reproduce command resolution with Get-Command py/python, inspect the resolved py file, then invoke the target python.exe directly.
cause: PATH resolves py to C:\Users\fredc\.local\bin\py, an extensionless POSIX shell wrapper beginning #!/bin/sh. PowerShell treats that path as an Application but cannot execute the shell script as a Windows executable. No py.exe or python.exe is resolvable on this process PATH. The Python runtime targeted by the wrapper is healthy.
falsifier: The hypothesis would be disproved if Get-Command resolved py to a Windows executable or if the extensionless wrapper executed successfully from the same PowerShell process while its target runtime failed.
observed_result: Get-Command resolved only C:\Users\fredc\.local\bin\py with no extension; its 112-byte content is a /bin/sh exec wrapper. Direct invocation failed, while C:\Users\fredc\.cache\codex-runtimes\codex-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe ran Python 3.12.13 and exited 0.
